segments.title: Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the cold open as 'Papita the dog' and initiates the live broadcast.

segments.title: Opening Banter & Buzz Buzz Roll Call
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle exchange morning greetings, run the 'buzz buzz' chat shoutout ritual, discuss Case's sleep-hair ridge, and accidentally cue Chet (Chrome) and a Burt impersonator bit.

segments.title: Columbia University Concedes to Trump Demands
segments.notes: Case and Liliana cover Columbia's policy overhaul under federal funding threat: protest restrictions, Middle Eastern studies review, new antisemitism definition, and Tel Aviv Center expansion; DOD rebrands DEI as 'discriminatory equity ideology'.

segments.title: Mask Doctor Interview
segments.notes: A flaming-skull 'mask doctor' (Scorpion-coded) discusses campus mask bans, fire-breathing physiology, crispy bacon/applesauce diet, and a fatal teleport-fist incident involving the Scorpions' drummer.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Grandman, Bert, Amanda, Shark, Lemon Squeeze, Yogi, Cosmic Tree, Ranger
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields a parade of park denizens: Grandman (BIN office handyman), Bert (shower-capped IOU holder), Amanda Huckinskiss (John Cena heartbreak), Shark Grimmick (Egyptian teen pyramid pitch), Lemon Squeeze (juice proposition), Yogi Bear (SNES cartridge/toelette snorting addict), Cosmic Tree (bush rivalry), and a skeleton park ranger with neck-lock.

segments.title: Big Chatter Speed Round: DMV Scalpers
segments.notes: Big Chatter arrives; Case runs a fiddle-trap backed speed round on Miami DMV appointment scalping ($250 resale), debates government funding vs. efficiency with Chet.

segments.title: Universe Inside a Black Hole? JADES Survey Finds Galactic Rotation Bias
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI break down NASA JADES data: 2/3 of 263 galaxies rotate opposite the expected random distribution, suggesting the universe may reside inside a rotating black hole; Chet resists Chaos Emerald temptation.

segments.title: Viral Speedrun: Feral Pig Bacteria, Valnet Sweatshop, Tamagotchi Vapes, LG NFTs, Gel Breakup, Ref Testicle Biting, Vabbing, Hamtaro Lens Woes, $4.4M Dog, Snickers Coffin, Cambodia Beefcake Pageant
segments.notes: Rapid-fire audience submissions: Florida man gets pig heart infection; Valnet (ScreenRant/CBR owner) accused of SEO sweatshop; NYU Stupid Hackathon yields vape-powered Tamagotchi; LG kills NFT marketplace; Gel guitarist allegedly stole bandmates' OnlyFans revenue; German child bites referee's testicle; vaginal-fluid perfume trend 'vabbing' debated; Case's Hamtaro Snapchat lenses broken by server update; half-wolf half-cane corso sells for $4.4M; UK man buried in Snickers coffin; Cambodian male beauty pageant goes viral.

segments.title: Bush vs. Tree Debate & Gorilla Menacing
segments.notes: Crum and Munch debate bush vs. tree (Crum: bush utility/sex appeal/God's burning bush; Munch: tree size/strength). Gorilla appears menacingly; Crum claims $25k paid over ~3 months (~$10k/mo), suggests Beyblade rematch as next sub goal.

segments.title: Family Feud Gerbil, Banana Peel Slip, Fake Tree Karma, Nutter Butter Man, Stone Penis Statue (Unaired), Trump Drapes
segments.notes: Jake hosts viewer clips: Family Feud 'gerbil' answer; banana peel slip test (disappointing); staged tree-falls-on-car karma video (9.8/10); Nutter Butter Golden Girls tribute; explicit stone penis statue declined; Trump discusses White House drapes/light damage.

segments.title: Bert's Porn Industry Exposé: Valnet Sweatshop
segments.notes: Bert delivers a country-trap backed breakdown of Valnet's acquisition playbook: contractor conversion, pay cuts, writer blacklists, SEO clickbait churn; closes with original rap 'Used to Be a Cowboy on the Internet'.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Dylan
segments.notes: Bert raids Dylan with improvised country rap; Case closes the broadcast.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the full broadcast: news desk, science desk handoff, debate moderation, Amongst the Web hosting, and sign-off.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open station sign-on as 'Papita the dog'.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-hosted the opening banter, ran the buzz-buzz chat roll call, and discussed upcoming streaming plans.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-anchored the Columbia University and DOD DEI stories, sparring with Case on political framing.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Commandeered the broadcast for the Chet Guy the Science Eyes desk on the black-hole universe theory; debated DMV funding with Case.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: AI co-host. Appeared on monitor alongside Chet, summarized the JADES survey findings, and hallucinated a brief laugh.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosted Trip on the Street from the park, interviewing a surreal lineup of pedestrians and entities.

characters.name: Grandman
characters.notes: call-in guest. BIN office handyman/IT/social organizer interviewed by Trip; dismissed as boring and 'finger-of-death'd'.

characters.name: Bert
characters.notes: call-in guest. Appeared twice: first as a shower-capped IOU holder fleeing a gorilla debt, later delivering the Valnet porn-industry exposé with original rap.

characters.name: Amanda Huckinskiss
characters.notes: call-in guest. Park interviewee mourning a breakup with John Cena; offered Trip a five-knuckle shuffle.

characters.name: Shark Grimmick
characters.notes: call-in guest. Pitched a 2600 BC Egyptian teen pyramid ripoff of That '70s Show; rejected by Trip.

characters.name: Lemon Squeeze
characters.notes: call-in guest. Flirtatious park denizen propositioning Trip for 'juice' extraction; deflected.

characters.name: Yogi Bear
characters.notes: call-in guest. Addicted to snorting crushed 1994 SNES cartridges, towelettes, and bees; framed picnic baskets as gateway drug.

characters.name: Cosmic Tree
characters.notes: call-in guest. Sentient tree concept battling the concept of Bush for eons; demanded acknowledgment from Trip.

characters.name: Park Ranger
characters.notes: call-in guest. Skeleton ranger with forward-only neck; reported Yogi Bear stealing picnic baskets and silverware.

characters.name: Big Chatter
characters.notes: call-in guest. Supersized chat entity claiming the Socrates nickname; introduced the fiddle-trap speed round.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for Bush in the Bush vs. Tree debate; revealed $25k paid to the Rock-afire gorilla over ~3 months; pushed Beyblade rematch.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for Tree; goaded Crum on gorilla debt and Beyblade standards (Beyblades!); celebrated debate win.

characters.name: Gorilla (Rock-afire animatronic)
characters.notes: studio prop/character. Menacing keyboard-playing creditor; appeared during debate, played low notes, blinked ambiguously; Crum claims paying ~$10k/month.

storylines.beat: [01:46:07] Crum states he has paid the Rock-afire gorilla ~$25,000 over approximately three months (~$10k/month) and claims they are becoming friends; gorilla remains menacing.
[01:47:13] Crum proposes a Beyblade rematch as the next sub goal; Munch insists on correct pronunciation ('Beyblades!') and notes Case's old Beyblades are broken.
[01:31:10] Case explains Snapchat server changes broke the Hamtaro lens scraper; developer promises update next week (version 3.4) to restore full Hamtaro suite.

lore_notes.fact: Pays the Rock-afire gorilla approximately $10,000 per month; total ~$25,000 over three months. [01:46:07]
Case's original Beyblades are broken; new ones would need to be purchased for any tournament. [01:47:13]
Works at BIN office as copier/printer refiller, IT, bathroom clog handyman, and unpaid social event organizer. [03:49]
Took a job from a man who owed $10,000 to the Rock-afire gorilla; received an IOU instead of payment. [00:41:13]
Has eyebrows, a very hairy body, and a clean-shaven face; once had a beard in younger years. [00:12:10]
Snapchat server updates broke the third-party lens scraper; developer version 3.4 expected next week to restore access. [01:31:10]

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Columbia University's capitulation to Trump administration funding threats, a flaming-skull mask doctor's fire-breathing physiology, and a park-side parade of surreal interviewees including a SNES-snorting Yogi Bear and a cosmic tree. The science desk confirmed the universe may reside inside a rotating black hole per JADES data, while the debate desk clashed over bush versus tree as the Rock-afire gorilla loomed over Crum's $25k debt. The broadcast closed with Bert's country-rap exposé on Valnet's porn-media sweatshop and a raid to Dylan.
